purpose: Teach: モットー/貸与/累計/問屋/立ち寄り/小売り/衣料/言明

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のモットーを覚えろ
lines.style: Measured and direct. Opens with his name like a call to attention. Steady pace, no hurry. The tone of a mentor who expects you to absorb and act. Not unkind, just clear about what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。機材の貸与制度を活用しております
lines.en: Yes. We're making use of the equipment loan system.
lines.style: Quick, eager to show understanding. Slightly stiff — wants to give the right answer. Respectful rhythm, like he's checking off a box. No decoration, just facts lined up neatly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の累計引用数を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — check the cumulative citation count on that paper.
lines.style: Same measured tone as before. Another task in a series. No inflection of doubt — assumes compliance. The voice of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。問屋経由で部品を調達しております
lines.en: Yes. We've been sourcing components through wholesalers.
lines.style: Stiff, slightly beside the point — like he's answering a different question. Respectful but defensive, as if offering information he hopes will satisfy. Careful, almost over-formal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会で他大学に立ち寄りで挨拶しろ
lines.en: Ren — when you're at the conference, stop by other universities and introduce yourself.
lines.style: Firmer instruction now. Opens with the name as a checkpoint. Deliberate pacing. The tone of someone giving advice he means Ren to take seriously and remember later.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。小売り市場のデータを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I've covered retail market data in the paper.
lines.style: Defensive again, offering something that doesn't quite meet the request. Polite but searching — like he's hoping this answer will work. Quiet, almost apologetic in rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、繊維素材の衣料品研究も視野に入れろ
lines.en: Ren — keep fiber and textile-based apparel research in your line of sight too.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. The tone of expansion — opening a door wider. Still composed, but with a hint of investment in Ren's thinking beyond the immediate. Patient instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究目的を学会で明確に言明します
lines.en: Yes. I'll state the research objectives clearly at the conference.
lines.style: Quieter close. A note of resolution in his voice — like he's taking the instruction as a real commitment. Respectful but with a thread of determination underneath. Trailing soft but not defeated.
